title: stat_article: O(n) contains() on sorted vec should use binary_search
description: In session/commands/group.rs, stat_article at line 152 calls gd.article_numbers.contains(&n) to check whether an article number exists. article_numbers is documented as a sorted ascending slice, so binary_search() or binary_search_by() would reduce the lookup from O(n) to O(log n). Under a group with many articles this is called on every STAT/ARTICLE/HEAD/BODY command. Fix: replace .contains(&n) with .binary_search(&n).is_ok().
